g.text: PapaPolar: why did the snowman go to therapy?
PapaPolar: because he had a... TOTAL MELTDOWN
Yeeeeah I'd rather go put holes in things, sorry. [End.]
Lol. All right. Why did the snowman go to therapy?
PapaPolar: that is the saddest thing i've ever...
Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank5Convo3.
PapaPolar: think a ball of snow on top of a bigger ball of snow on top of a bigger ball of snow
PapaPolar: with two pieces of coal for eyes and a big 'ol carrot for a nose
PapaPolar: Why was the snowman looking through the carrots?
And that's supposed to look like a human?
I... need to go save the world. Or... fight evil... or... sort my socks... or something. [End.]
PapaPolar: i mean, yes? but no? it's not the point - it's a thing people do when -
MomToxicated: It's just something fun to do outside when it's snowed and the world's taken a moment to slow down.
PapaPolar: egh. on second thought, never mind.
Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank5Convo3.
MomToxicated: And "ball" is an easy shape to make with snow.
PapaPolar: shit. i forget. damn it.
MomToxicated: Besides. They're cheery looking, when everything is cold and bleak.
Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank5Convo3.
I want to build a snowman. :)
MomToxicated: Because he was picking his nose.
PapaPolar: i'd love to show you how. :-D
... Wait. But I need to know the answer!!
PapaPolar: eh, it'll come to me eventually.
PapaPolar: why did the snowman go to therapy?
MomToxicated: You told that to the foreign delegation committee when we were in Cité de la Lumière.
PapaPolar: oh right! hahhaha. i forgot all about that trip. i thought you were too busy slipping poison into the chancellor's wine.
Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank5Convo3.
MomToxicated: I was busy, but it doesn't mean I wasn't listening. You were my cover. And you almost blew it for me when I laughed.
PapaPolar: and if i remember correctly, we went to that place with the amazing escargot after, didn't we?
MomToxicated: We did. And had to leave very quickly when the Rus showed up angry as a swarm of bees.
MomToxicated: Never got to finish that bottle of wine.
PapaPolar: well, Longshot McExtremelyBritannic and friends came up with a new batch of moonshine
PapaPolar: not exactly a bottle of red worth my year's salary but hey. care to pick up where we left off?
MomToxicated: Mm. Beggars and choosers and all that jazz. Count me in.
Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank5Convo3.
